evidence_excerpts: For m = 20, obtaining a million samples on the quantum processor takes 200 seconds, whereas an equal-fidelity classical sampling would take 10,000 years on a million cores.
text: For the hardest reported random-circuit sampling task, Sycamore produced one million samples in about 200 seconds while the authors estimated equal-fidelity classical sampling would take about 10,000 years on one million cores.
